visual_goal: Show the book's route: preface, then Parts I to V in sequence, with the reference pages serving the parts.
prompt: A left-to-right winding road of flat stepping stones. At the far left a small signpost labeled 'Preface'. Then stones labeled in order: 'Part I Foundations', 'Part II Platforms', 'Part III Integration', 'Part IV Leadership', 'Part V Practice', each joined to the next by one arrow along the road. Below the road, centered, a simple wooden bookshelf filled only with plain books with blank spines, labeled 'Toolkit'. Three thin dashed arrows go down into the bookshelf: one from 'Part I Foundations', one from 'Part III Integration', one from 'Part IV Leadership'. Exactly eight arrows.
alt: A road from the preface through Parts I to V, with dashed links from Parts I, III and IV to a toolkit bookshelf of templates and references.
